fusions.name: Flattening Stamp
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A pounding stamp that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and slows each by 25% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Levelling Stomp
fusions.desc: Brings a hoof down flat, which deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Set Like an Anvil
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% and your blunt resistance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Beaten Flat
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.
